mapper.insert: INSERT INTO run_manifest (id, run_kind, run_id, seq, request_id, parent_request_id, workspace_id, subject, trace_id, agent_version_id, spec_hash, grant_id, manifest_json, content_hash, prev_hash, hash) VALUES (#{id}, #{runKind}, #{runId}, #{seq}, #{requestId}, #{parentRequestId}, #{workspaceId}, #{subject}, #{traceId}, #{agentVersionId}, #{specHash}, #{grantId}, #{manifestJson}::jsonb, #{contentHash}, #{prevHash}, #{hash})
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_kind AS runKind, run_id AS runId, seq, request_id AS requestId, parent_request_id AS parentRequestId, workspace_id AS workspaceId, subject, trace_id AS traceId, agent_version_id AS agentVersionId, spec_hash AS specHash, grant_id AS grantId, manifest_json::text AS manifestJson, content_hash AS contentHash, prev_hash AS prevHash, hash, create_at AS createAt, create_by AS createBy FROM run_manifest WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, run_kind AS runKind, run_id AS runId, seq, request_id AS requestId, parent_request_id AS parentRequestId, workspace_id AS workspaceId, subject, trace_id AS traceId, agent_version_id AS agentVersionId, spec_hash AS specHash, grant_id AS grantId, manifest_json::text AS manifestJson, content_hash AS contentHash, prev_hash AS prevHash, hash, create_at AS createAt, create_by AS createBy FROM run_manifest WHERE run_kind = #{runKind} AND run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, run_kind AS runKind, run_id AS runId, seq, request_id AS requestId, parent_request_id AS parentRequestId, workspace_id AS workspaceId, subject, trace_id AS traceId, agent_version_id AS agentVersionId, spec_hash AS specHash, grant_id AS grantId, manifest_json::text AS manifestJson, content_hash AS contentHash, prev_hash AS prevHash, hash, create_at AS createAt, create_by AS createBy FROM run_manifest WHERE run_kind = #{runKind} AND run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY seq ASC

SELECT id, run_kind AS runKind, run_id AS runId, seq, request_id AS requestId, parent_request_id AS parentRequestId, workspace_id AS workspaceId, subject, trace_id AS traceId, agent_version_id AS agentVersionId, spec_hash AS specHash, grant_id AS grantId, manifest_json::text AS manifestJson, content_hash AS contentHash, prev_hash AS prevHash, hash, create_at AS createAt, create_by AS createBy FROM run_manifest WHERE 1 = 1
AND create_at >= #{from}::timestamptz
AND create_at <= #{to}::timestamptz
ORDER BY create_at ASC, id ASC
